prompt: There is a bug report in ISSUE.md. Fix the code in this folder so the issue is resolved. Do not ask questions; make the fix.
final_response:
Fixed `ratelimit.py` so that:

- New buckets start full at `capacity`.
- Tokens refill continuously and fractionally without losing fractional remainders.
- Refill is capped at `capacity`, preventing burst overshoot.
- Repeated calls with the same `now` do not add tokens.
- Tokens are only consumed when at least one is available.

All tested scenarios pass.
